boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named academic and library environments documented by USMMA sources; confirm building and room availability locally before relying on a particular seat.

cards.title: Schuyler Otis Bland Memorial Library
cards.subtitle: Research, reference, and reading resources
cards.notes: Start here for curriculum-supporting research and reading materials. Visitors should call ahead to schedule an appointment, and federal-holiday closures apply.
cards.short_summary: USMMA identifies Bland as its library and a curriculum-supporting resource center.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says the library provides reference, research, and reading material supporting the curriculum.
cards.access_notes: Visitors must contact the library in advance at 516-726-5751 to schedule a visit; the library is closed on federal holidays.

cards.title: Bland Library Student Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Schuyler Otis Bland Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use these closed-study-room spaces for a contained work session. The published space program does not state booking rules, so confirm availability with library staff.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s 2025 library space program includes eight closed study rooms for students.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA's Campus Modernization Plan lists eight closed study rooms for students within special-purpose library space.
cards.source_title: USMMA Campus Modernization Plan: Library Department Space Requirements
cards.access_notes: The published space program does not provide reservation or public-access rules; ask the library before planning a session.

cards.title: Bland Library Open Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Schuyler Otis Bland Memorial Library
cards.notes: Choose an open study area when a private room is unnecessary. The plan identifies two such areas but does not publish seating layouts or current availability.
cards.short_summary: The Academy’s library space program identifies two open study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA's Campus Modernization Plan lists two open study areas in the library's special-purpose space.
cards.source_title: USMMA Campus Modernization Plan: Library Department Space Requirements
cards.access_notes: No seating, reservation, or public-access rules are published for these areas; verify conditions with library staff.

cards.title: Bland Library Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Schuyler Otis Bland Memorial Library
cards.notes: Consider this documented 20-person computer-lab setting for computer-based coursework. Check locally for hours, class use, and workstation availability before going.
cards.short_summary: USMMA's library program calls for one 20-person computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA's Campus Modernization Plan specifies one 20-person computer lab in the Library Department space requirements.
cards.source_title: USMMA Campus Modernization Plan: Library Department Space Requirements
cards.access_notes: The plan does not state computer-lab hours, class scheduling, or walk-in eligibility.

cards.title: Bland Library Periodical Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Schuyler Otis Bland Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use the periodical reading room for work alongside journals and reports. Confirm that the room is open and whether materials have any handling restrictions.
cards.short_summary: The library space program specifically includes a periodical reading room.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA's Campus Modernization Plan includes a periodical reading room in the library's special-purpose space.
cards.source_title: USMMA Campus Modernization Plan: Library Department Space Requirements
cards.access_notes: The published plan does not give room hours or material-use rules; confirm details with the library.

cards.title: Bland Library Humanities Reading Nook
cards.subtitle: Schuyler Otis Bland Memorial Library
cards.notes: Use this named reading-nook setting for humanities material when available. The space program groups it with library lecture space, so verify its current setup first.
cards.short_summary: USMMA's library space program names a Humanities reading nook.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA's Campus Modernization Plan includes a Humanities reading nook within two shared library lecture spaces.
cards.source_title: USMMA Campus Modernization Plan: Library Department Space Requirements
cards.access_notes: No public hours or independent-use policy is stated for the reading nook or associated lecture spaces.

cards.title: Academic Center for Excellence
cards.subtitle: 300 Steamboat Road
cards.notes: Plan tutoring or a regimental study-hall session through ACE. Its listed general hours run Monday through Friday, while tutoring and study halls follow separate schedules.
cards.short_summary: ACE publishes general weekday hours and coordinates tutoring and term-arranged regimental study halls.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA lists ACE weekday operating hours and says peer tutoring and regimental study halls are arranged each term by ACE staff and the RAO.
cards.source_title: Academic Center for Excellence Hours of Operation
cards.access_notes: General ACE hours: Mon 0730–1900, Tue 0730–1800, Wed–Fri closing 1700; tutoring and study halls are separately scheduled.

cards.title: Fulton Hall
cards.subtitle: Marine engineering and science building
cards.notes: Use Fulton Hall as an academic-building waypoint for marine engineering and science work. The public campus description does not state open-study seating or after-hours access.
cards.short_summary: USMMA identifies Fulton Hall as its marine engineering and science building.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA describes Fulton Hall as the marine engineering and science building.
cards.access_notes: The public source confirms the building’s academic function but does not publish study-space availability or access rules.

cards.title: Gibbs Hall
cards.subtitle: Science and engineering laboratories
cards.notes: Use Gibbs Hall as a named academic location when working around science or engineering lab commitments. Do not assume laboratory access without course or staff authorization.
cards.short_summary: USMMA documents modern science and engineering laboratories in Gibbs Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says Gibbs Hall contains modern science and engineering laboratories.
cards.access_notes: The public source confirms laboratories but does not state independent study or laboratory-access rules.

cards.title: Samuels Hall - GMATS
cards.subtitle: Humanities classrooms and nautical-science laboratories
cards.notes: Use Samuels Hall as an academic waypoint for humanities and nautical-science coursework. Verify classroom availability and any required authorization before settling in.
cards.short_summary: USMMA documents Humanities classrooms, computer resources, a bridge simulator, and nautical-science labs at Samuels Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: USMMA says Samuels Hall contains Humanities classrooms, the Computer Resources Office, a ship's bridge simulator, and laboratories for teaching nautical science.
cards.access_notes: The public source lists academic facilities but does not publish open-study seating, room schedules, or visitor access.

warnings: Several library subspaces are documented in the Academy’s 2025 space program; the public materials do not confirm current room-by-room availability or booking rules.
No verified coordinate or place-specific maps link was published for the individual interior study environments, so those fields are null or use the official campus-map page.
